 사진 확대 Photo: MBC ‘Oh Eun-young Report - Marriage Hell’ will not air due to coverage of the 2026 KBO postseason playoffs.
 On the 26th, MBC announced, “Episode 189 of ‘Oh Eun-young Report - Marriage Hell,’ which was scheduled to air that day, was canceled due to coverage of Game 1 of the 2026 postseason playoffs.”
 As a result, episode 189 of ‘Oh Eun-young Report - Marriage Hell’ will air on November 2.
 Game 1 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL Korea Baseball Organization (KBO) postseason playoffs, between the Samsung Lions and Kia Tigers, will be played at Daegu Samsung Lions Park starting at 6:30 p.m. that day.
 The game had originally been scheduled for 2 p.m. on the 25th, but was postponed after being called off due to rain.
